meta.frozen_before_evidence: at freeze time no experiments/results/matrix/ directory exists; the only solver artifacts are results/pilot/pilot_M1NC_seed100.json (seed_index 0, degenerate anchor variant). No W/H full-matrix result has been observed.
meta.registration_scope: spec D10 pins the replication structure (5 variants x 10 seeds) and seed pinning, but no statistical analysis plan. This file is the SOLE registration of the analysis plan. It does not modify any frozen quantity: promotion threshold 6.0 dB (promotion_prereg.json), AASR main -13 dB (D7), scatter ratio 0.1 (D10/A6) all remain untouched.
meta.statistical_precedent: papers/single-sat-quality/experiments/analysis.py paired_comparison (Wilcoxon signed-rank + Cliff's delta, zero_method='wilcox', two-sided) and Friedman/Nemenyi across variants; mirrored here to avoid a second calibration.

matrix_scope.seed_rule: seed = variant_index*100 + seed_index, seed_index in [0,9] (scenario_manifest_template.json seed_convention, D08-9)

solver_config_pinned.source: scripts/run_pilot.py defaults, identical to the pilot runs; frozen before matrix launch, no post-hoc tuning

matrix_scope.artifact_contract: one results/matrix/pilot_<FAM>_seed<S>.json per unit, schema pilot-result/1.1, written by run_pilot.py --out; units ending exit 10/11 leave no artifact and are recorded in the driver progress file

metrics.f1_star_max: max over front records of f1_star (anchor-normalized coverage, D8); the unit's anchor_f1_star is recorded alongside and is the greedy-anchor baseline for the primary test
metrics.f_q_front: front records carry f_q (delivered quality, D6 aggregate mean over served set)
metrics.hv: hypervolume of the (f1_star, f_q) front with reference point (0, 0). No max-side min-max normalization is applied, so the D6/steel-man-A16 envelope ban (references only from the all-mode common envelope, never per-mode self-best) is satisfied by construction.
metrics.promotion_readout: per unit: promotion.spread_db and promotion.decision as written by the evaluator (D12-3 domain: unenforced AASR spread); threshold 6.0 dB frozen

trivialization_readout.per_unit: count of distinct f_q values among front records (rounded to 1e-6) and Spearman rho between f1_star and f_q over front records
trivialization_readout.per_variant_verdict: median across the 10 seeds of distinct-f_q count; the H/W front is declared TRIVIALIZED iff the median is < 3
trivialization_readout.reason: operationalizes a6_adjudication_20260929.md Appendix B ('f_Q 与 f1* 单调可换、非平凡权衡点 < 3'); if any W/H variant trivializes, the second-leg narrative requires rework and a new adjudication -- pre-declared here so the criterion is fixed before data

per_mode_fq_decomposition.status: REQUIRED deliverable (a6 adjudication 2026-09-29, ruling 2, bound to writing phase)
per_mode_fq_decomposition.computation: from matrix fronts: per selected task, mode label -> share of |S| and per-mode mean f_Q,i for STR/SLS/SPT; mode-level constants table alongside (f_Q ~ 1/rho_a_ach^2 per-mode lookup, D05-3/D05-4)
per_mode_fq_decomposition.consumes: D05-5 dual-weighting disclosure in the paper (implicit 1/rho_req priority weighting via rho_a_ach AND effective rho_a^2 azimuth weighting via g_T) -- both must be stated, neither alone

tests.pairing: paired across the 10 seeds within a variant (same variant, 10 scenario replicates)

primary_comparison.what: NSGA-II max_f1_star vs greedy anchor f1_star, per variant
primary_comparison.effect_size: Cliff's delta with ties counting half, interpreted as in paper 1 (_cliffs_interpretation)
primary_comparison.multiplicity: 5 primary tests (one per variant); report raw p and Holm-Bonferroni-adjusted p across the 5; alpha = 0.05
primary_comparison.n_guard: n < 5 valid pairs -> test not run, reported as insufficient (paper-1 analysis.py same guard)

secondary_comparison.what: Friedman across the 5 variants on per-seed HV and on per-seed max_f1_star; Nemenyi post-hoc if Friedman rejects
secondary_comparison.guard: run only if >= 3 variants contribute >= 5 valid units each; otherwise reported as not run

tests.valid_unit_rule: exit-0 artifacts only. Exit-11 (empty front) units are excluded from tests but their count is reported per variant and never silently dropped; exit-10 anywhere aborts analysis (generation defect, alarm)

forbidden: changing any frozen threshold after seeing results: promotion 6.0 dB, AASR -13 dB main, scatter ratio 0.1, solver pop/gen

numeric cross-variant claims that M?NC anchors 'regress to the fixed-duration world' in numbers (spec Testing Decisions: M1NC platform is Kim X-band, differs from paper 1 platform -- semantic-level regression claim only, 论文禁数值级对照声明)
per-seed cherry-picking: all 10 seeds are reported per variant; headline numbers are medians/means over seeds as registered here
adding or dropping metrics or tests after data inspection; additions only via amendment fields (below)
amendment_discipline: additions or corrections are appended as amendment_<date>_<slug> fields with rationale; frozen fields are never mutated in place. The promotion_prereg.json amendment_20260929_ticket13 pattern is the precedent.

amendment_20260930_probe_density.rationale: Post-hoc density probe, decided in session 2026-09-30 AFTER the full matrix was observed (both registered observations triggered: H/W trivialization + no_promotion 50/50) and BEFORE any probe data exists. Purpose: locate the density phase boundary of the H/W frontier on the WH family, which decides the narrative restructure (regime/phase-transition story) vs collapse. Appended per amendment_discipline; no frozen field mutated.

scope.seed_rule: same convention: seed = variant_index*100 + seed_index, seed_index in [0,4]
scope.solver_config: identical to matrix_scope.solver_config_pinned (pop 40 / gen 60 / anchor_seeded); reused verbatim, no retuning
scope.artifacts: experiments/results/probe_density/pilot_<FAM>_seed<S>.json (same pilot-result/1.1 schema, written by run_pilot.py --out); frozen matrix artifacts and matrix statistics untouched

pre_declared_criteria.revival: a probe variant is NOT trivialized iff the median distinct-f_q over its 5 seeds >= 3 (exact inverse of the registered trivialization verdict; same 1e-6 rounding)
pre_declared_criteria.promotion_alive: promotion is alive at a probe density iff any of its 5 seeds has spread_db >= 6.0 dB (threshold unchanged)
pre_declared_criteria.phase_boundary: report the density set {20, 40, 60, 80, 100, 500} with per-variant median distinct-f_q and max spread_db; M2WH@100 and M4WH@500 supply the >= 100 side from the frozen matrix; boundary = the highest density whose variant is not trivialized
pre_declared_criteria.interpretation: if any probe density revives, the trade-off existence boundary lies inside [20,100] and the phase-transition narrative is supported; if none revive, the second-leg narrative collapses to scarcity-mechanism only

amendment_20260930_probe_density.exclusions: probe units are NOT part of the frozen matrix tests (primary/secondary comparisons); they feed the phase table only
